## About
RH Construction and Structural is led by licensed general contractor Rafael Herrera. Rafael and his team take on home additions, foundation work, seismic upgrades and custom decks across the Bay Area, big or small.
We're guided by integrity, clear communication and a commitment to quality. One reviewer noted that Rafael was on the job himself every day, working right alongside his crew.
Neighbors have given us a 5-star Google rating across 28 reviews.

## Services
- Additions: Home additions built to last, planned around how you live.
- Retaining Wall Work: Strong, reliable retaining walls for your property.
- Foundation Work: Foundation repair and installation, including cracks found along the way.
- Drainage Systems: When water is getting where it shouldn't, Rafael finds why the drainage isn't working and offers a fix.
- Brace and Bolt Program: Bolting and bracing homes to their foundations through the California Brace & Bolt program.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get started?
A: Call or message us, then book a visit for a free quote. We'll take it from there.

Q: Do you take on small jobs?
A: Yes. Minor repairs or major builds, every project gets the same care.

Q: Can you help with the Earthquake Brace and Bolt program?
A: Yes. Ron Maeder wrote that Rafael handled communicating the finished work to the state program so he could receive his grant money.

## What customers say
- "I felt lucky that I found Rafael Herrera of RH CONSTRUCTION AND STRUCTURAL to repair and retrofit the rotten exposed foundation posts and beams in my 1973 pole-lifted house on a sloping site.
Before contacting Rafael, I already talked to several other contractors. A general contractor suggested I should rebuild the whole house because he estimated the cost would be huge and not worth the repair. Another foundation expert company was very kind and sent an engineer and a project manager to look at the conditions. But they thought the project scope was too small for their company. They referred me to another contractor. That contractor brought a structural engineer to look on-site. I was waiting for the response. After a week or two, that contractor told me the structural engineer decided not to accept the work because he has never worked on similar house construction method before.
I was desperate after not getting any good/suitable proposal from several contractors on how to fix the issue. I searched for building contractors on Google Map and read through reviews on them. One of the contractors from the search result was RH Construction. A lot of great reviews on the company are related to foundation projects. “Eureka!” I found the right contractor!
Rafael gave me a structural engineer’s contact. I hired that structural engineer to do on-site observation and to make the key plans and drawings for permit application. Rafael provided a reasonable price quote based on the key plans. He also handled the city permit application for the project. During the project period, Rafael and his team discovered new damages unseen originally. The structural engineer was called again to provide advice and solutions. The finished work passed the city inspection successfully.
THANK YOU, Rafael.
I am totally satisfied with the work quality provided by Rafael and his team. I will recommend RH CONSTRUCTION AND STRUCTURAL to anyone who has home remodeling/building needs." (Kathy Chung, 5/5)
- "When we looked for contractors to do the earthquake retrofit work of our 50+ year old house, Rafael was recommended by a friend’s daughter who is a plumbing contractor herself. We also did our own due diligence. He is among the top 5% of 336,931 contractors in California.

Rafael and his team did their job well. The actual work took less than a day. But there is lots of paperwork involved in the EBB process to be qualified for the $3000 rebate. Rafael is familiar with all that and took care of them. There are some official requirements for the minimum reinforcement brackets for each beam. Their team went beyond that with additional brackets.

Their workmanship is also trusted by the city inspector so much that he did not even need to encounter our house. Rafael’s photos taken on the inspection day are good enough to pass the inspection. That tells a lot about his reputation." (Ken Chan, 5/5)
